title: Уникальный индекс

negative.sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_menu_unique ON menu (pizzeria_id, pizza_name);
EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM menu WHERE pizzeria_id = 1 AND pizza_name = 'cheese pizza';

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_menu_unique ON menu (pizza_name, pizzeria_id);
EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM menu WHERE pizzeria_id = 1 AND pizza_name = 'cheese pizza';

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_menu_unique ON menu (pizzeria_id);
EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM menu WHERE pizzeria_id = 1 AND pizza_name = 'cheese pizza';

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_menu_uniq ON menu (pizzeria_id, pizza_name);
EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM menu WHERE pizzeria_id = 1 AND pizza_name = 'cheese pizza';
